memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Insomnia: ongoing, reports difficulty falling asleep, melatonin and trazodone continued. Plan: reinforce sleep hygiene, consider CBT-I if no improvement.
Migraine: 2-3 episodes/month on propranolol prophylaxis, sumatriptan effective. Plan: continue prophylaxis, monitor for side effects.
Allergic rhinitis: perennial symptoms, nasal spray and antihistamine used. Plan: continue intranasal steroid, add montelukast if needed.
Weight 78 kg, waist circumference 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for male) – central obesity. Diet advice: breakfast – high‑protein, low‑glycemic; lunch – mixed vegetables with lean protein; dinner – light, avoid carbs after 8 pm.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-07-05).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
melatonin 3 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 4.2 µIU/mL (Ref 0.4‑4.0) – mildly elevated.
 Haemoglobin 13.8 g/dL (Ref 13.0‑17.0).
 HbA1c 6.0 % (Ref <5.7) – pre‑diabetic range.
 Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 180 mg/dL (<150).
 Total serum IgE 120 IU/mL (Ref <100) – elevated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Skin prick test: positive reaction to house dust mite (3+), grass pollen (2+), negative to cat dander. Consistent with allergic rhinitis.
 Plan: continue allergen avoidance, consider immunotherapy if symptoms persist.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
CT head (non‑contrast): no acute infarct, hemorrhage, or mass lesion. Normal ventricular size. No abnormal enhancement. 
 Interpretation: study rules out structural cause for migraine; migraine likely primary.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Insomnia: reports improved sleep latency after melatonin increase to 5 mg HS; trazodone unchanged. No daytime fatigue.
Migraine: only 1 mild episode in past month, sumatriptan used once. Propranolol well tolerated, HR 62 bpm.
Allergic rhinitis: nasal congestion worse in mornings; cetirizine causing mild daytime drowsiness. Plan: switch to levocetirizine 5 mg HS, continue fluticasone, add montelukast 10 mg HS.
Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off). Diet advice: breakfast – Greek yogurt with nuts; lunch – quinoa salad with chickpeas; dinner – steamed fish with vegetables, avoid fried foods.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-10-20).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling sleepier in the mornings since I started cetirizine. It’s making it hard to stay alert during my morning mail route. Can we try something else?

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Insomnia: sleep latency back to baseline (~30 min) despite melatonin 5 mg; trazodone effective. Plan: keep melatonin 3 mg HS, increase trazodone to 75 mg HS.
Migraine: 0 episodes in last 6 weeks, propranolol continued. No adverse effects.
Allergic rhinitis: symptoms well controlled on levocetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast. No drowsiness.
Weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (<90) – improved central obesity. Diet advice: maintain current pattern, add evening walk 30 min.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2026-02-05). Lipid profile due annually (next 2026-04-05).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

Migraine: no headaches for 3 months, propranolol 40 mg OD continued.
Allergic rhinitis: asymptomatic, continues levocetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast.
Weight 75 kg, waist 86 cm. Diet advice: breakfast – oatmeal with berries; lunch – lentil soup with whole‑grain roll; dinner – grilled chicken with salad.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2026-05-15).

memories.text: Allergy: penicillin – rash (maculopapular) noted after a course for sinusitis in 2023. Avoid penicillin and beta‑lactams; use alternatives if needed.

memories.text:

Allergic rhinitis: asymptomatic, continues current meds.
